entries.name: ADP runtime
entries.summary: The adp/2 page runtime: the What changed panel, content as data, part-id comment anchors, page integrity, settings (ADP.config), the viewer (ADP.user), namespaced data (ADP.ns), seeding on first open and the page self-check.

entries.name: Refusal callout
entries.summary: An upgrade of kit.callout: an error that names the code, the field refused, what is allowed now and the system's own message.

entries.name: Callouts and inference marks
entries.summary: Note, verified, warn, danger and pending callouts with a kicker and a glaze orb, plus inline verified, inference, estimate and unverified marks.

entries.name: Canvas
entries.summary: A free drawing surface: select, move, resize, marquee, pan and pinch zoom, pen, highlighter, eraser, shapes, arrows that attach, text, sticky notes, record cards, undo and redo.

entries.name: Chrome primitives
entries.summary: Dialog with a field list, toast with an action, busy overlay with progress, click-twice button, auto-growing text field, outside-click hook, chips and one icon set.

entries.name: Claude lane
entries.summary: Sends a request to the Claude Code session that has the page open, queues it on the board when nobody listens, and shows each request’s answer state: queued, acknowledged, working, answered.

entries.name: Rotating code card
entries.summary: A short-lived code in large type with a draining ring and the seconds left in words. The default code is a demonstration, not a secret.

entries.name: Code block with copy
entries.summary: Labelled code blocks with a copy button, a click-to-copy command grid, and the fallback that selects the text where the clipboard is refused.

entries.name: Segmented dial
entries.summary: Segmented control with a sliding thumb (preview as, audience); arrow keys, digit keys, reduced motion; inline redaction marks.

entries.name: DOM helpers
entries.summary: el and sv, the two element builders the kit scripts share: one for HTML, one for SVG.

entries.name: Side drawer
entries.summary: A floating panel at the right with a head, a scrolling body and a pinned foot; Escape closes it and focus goes back to the button that opened it.

entries.name: Glaze surfaces
entries.summary: Porcelain-made parts in CSS: glossy beads, lacquer buttons, sunken fields, a switch, soft rows, lit cards with a pooled foot, an avatar disc and the kiln fleck layer.

entries.name: Artifact dataplane (ADP)
entries.summary: The standard every shared artifact follows: part ids, hashes, the db layout, the read, hold, publish, record protocol, and the adp/2 layout.

entries.name: Component inventory
entries.summary: What both boards build today, function by function, with its db reads and writes, its coupling and what it takes to share it.

entries.name: Icon map
entries.summary: An inline SVG icon set for everyday glyphs, as a string, an element or a vnode, in line, fill and two-tone variants.

entries.name: Keep typing across a re-render
entries.summary: Save drafts, focus, selection and open sections before a live page redraws, and put them back after.

entries.name: App shell with page registry
entries.summary: A floating nav pill whose icon tabs open their label on the current page; pages register themselves with show and hide hooks; hash routing; a link to something inside a page opens that page.

entries.name: Carousel strip
entries.summary: A sideways strip of cards: snap scrolling, arrow buttons that disable at the ends, edge fades only where more cards wait, mouse drag and arrow keys.

entries.name: Document shell with sticky contents
entries.summary: A sticky contents rail that marks the section in view, beside a 65ch reading column with optional marginalia; a Contents menu under 760px.

entries.name: Explorer shell
entries.summary: Sections as a file tree with kind badges, a pipeline of phases, and a status bar with live counts.

entries.name: File browser
entries.summary: The published files of an ADP artifact as a tree you can walk, and a sheet per file: its hash, the versions that touched it, its parts with who holds them and their comments, and its history with a Compare for each step.

entries.name: Clause with margin notes
entries.summary: Numbered clauses with an aside in the margin for state, owner, answer and acknowledgement; history as footnotes.

entries.name: Stacked sections
entries.summary: Full-height sections that rise over each other, with the tall-section fix, a progress bar, step N of M and previous and next footers.

entries.name: Sticky top bar with theme toggle
entries.summary: A sticky header with brand, section links that mark the one in view, and a three-state theme button; clears the phone's safe-area band.

entries.name: 3D viewer with parameters
entries.summary: A WebGL viewport beside a sidebar of view controls, number parameters, fixed dimensions and readouts that pass or fail; the model rebuilds on input.

entries.name: Markdown
entries.summary: Markdown to sanitized HTML with marked and DOMPurify, a plain-text fallback, and styles for a .md container.

entries.name: Themed Mermaid
entries.summary: Mermaid diagrams in the page's own tokens, redrawn on a theme change, in a frame with caption, legend and a sideways scroll.

entries.name: Command palette
entries.summary: A keyboard-opened search over a page's sections and records: Ctrl+K, arrow keys, Enter, Escape.

entries.name: Answer a run of items
entries.summary: A dialog with tabs for one item; answering opens the next waiting item, or says all caught up.

entries.name: Assist panel
entries.summary: The page's lane to Claude in one panel: whether a session watches, a composer (kind, block, words) that sends to a session or asks Claude at once, and the feed of request cards or the current conversation.

entries.name: Assist engine
entries.summary: The engine of a page that works with Claude: pick a block, send it as a request a watching Claude Code session does and reports on, or ask Claude at once; requests, turns, conversations and presence live in the db.

entries.name: Needs you list
entries.summary: One sentence saying how things are, then the things that need a person, worst first, each with the one button that deals with it; or a calm empty state.

entries.name: Block picker
entries.summary: Point at one block of the page before saying what you want about it: the page dims around one [data-part] block at a time, a bar names it, and Enter, a click or Pick this block returns its id, title, hash and text.

entries.name: Service blueprint
entries.summary: Swimlane table: touchpoints, what the person does and feels, frontstage, backstage and support, per step, with the lines of interaction and visibility.

entries.name: Capability picker
entries.summary: A switch per capability that says what it needs; turning one on includes its prerequisites, and a sentence states the order it will run; kinds that cannot mix say so.

entries.name: Card history
entries.summary: One record's story: a track with a node where its state changed, the turns as ask, answer and reply, then moves grouped by day.

entries.name: Confirm sheet by risk
entries.summary: A dialog for a change that has consequences: the plan in order with before and after, what it needs and holds, how to undo it; for the dangerous ones a typed word that seals it.

entries.name: Count tiles as filters
entries.summary: Tiles that show a count per status and filter the view when pressed, with chip groups and a search box in a strip that can stay under a sticky bar.

entries.name: Decision cards with an acknowledgement
entries.summary: An upgrade of pattern.decisions: what an answered card shows, the answer and who gave it, the prompt line, and an acknowledgement as a rubber stamp, a terminal line or a sticky note that can ask back.

entries.name: Owner decision cards
entries.summary: Decision cards where one tap records the owner's answer and a status line shows where Claude is with it.

entries.name: Reference reader: filter, index and glance tiles
entries.summary: An upgrade of pattern.disclosure: glance tiles, a filter box that says "3 of 9 sections" with a designed empty state, and an index that follows the section in view.

entries.name: Disclosure cards and reader bar
entries.summary: Native details cards with a summary line (cadence or date) and an expand-all and collapse-all bar; task, letter and numbered-clause looks.

entries.name: Event log and activity feed
entries.summary: Every move newest first: days that fold with a count and a dot strip, repeats folded into one row with a count chip, and a sticky panel for the selected move with Newer and Older.

entries.name: Expandable work card
entries.summary: A workstream card with a status matrix of symbol-and-word cells and an expanding body; remembers what is open.

entries.name: Upgrade: facets with a batch bar
entries.summary: Count chips whose counts say what pressing them gives, digit keys that switch the filter, a group-by and sort bar, selectable rows and a bar that acts on the selection.

entries.name: Key figures and hero
entries.summary: A report hero with stamp, summary chips and count-up figures, and four figure layouts: hairline grid, status tiles, three-up strip and facts.

entries.name: File map
entries.summary: Every published file at once, its area true to its share of the bytes or the parts, with changed, held and commented files marked, so the weight and the work show before anything is opened.

entries.name: Filter, search and sort table
entries.summary: Status chips with counts, a search box and sortable column heads over a table; optional group rows and a total in the status line.

entries.name: Finding cards
entries.summary: Severity finding cards (critical, high, medium, low, clear) with a kind tag, the evidence, where/what pairs and a fix, sorted worst first with a count line.

entries.name: Approval gate
entries.summary: A request to allow an action: who asks and for what, its risk and reversibility, a preview of the change, then Approve, Reject with a reason the asker reads, or Withdraw.

entries.name: Inbox card
entries.summary: The page end of the loop: the proposals in incoming/, classified on open, each part as before and after, held items with both versions and a recorded pick, Apply through the files form with an ifMatch per file, Decline with a reason, and who is watching.

entries.name: Integrity check
entries.summary: A page view that says whether an artifact's live files, its database records and its holds agree: a verdict with a Run button, then files, changes, holds and the self-check on one seam.

entries.name: Jobs tray
entries.summary: Work in progress as capsules in a tray: running, waiting for you, done, failed; the log follows the end, waiting jobs come first, and the head says it in a sentence.

entries.name: Settled ledger
entries.summary: Grouped, dated ledger of settled items with filter chips that show counts and rows that open to outcome, call and answer.

entries.name: Master-detail with filters
entries.summary: A filterable, searchable list on the left and the selected record on the right; the list becomes a select when the component is narrow.

entries.name: Mind map
entries.summary: A mind-map you make and arrange with drag and drop: a tidy tree left to right, add, edit and delete nodes, drop on a node or on a line between siblings, and a Move to menu that does every drop from the keyboard.

entries.name: Namespaces
entries.summary: Who can write where on an ADP artifact, read-only: each db rule as a path, a sentence and a ladder of the four levels, what you can do there, and the locked part prefixes with the parts they cover.

entries.name: Next steps with prompt builder
entries.summary: Checklist of next steps that builds a copyable prompt (or a command) from the picked ones; reorder, notes, own steps, collapsible strip.

entries.name: Options and the pick
entries.summary: Option cards with pros and cons and a picked card, tier cards from strongest to partial, and the pill that marks a verdict in a comparison table row.

entries.name: Playbook tabs and pipeline
entries.summary: Tabs of playbooks, each a numbered list of copyable commands; and a pipeline stepper whose open stage shows its detail.

entries.name: Playground
entries.summary: Try any catalog entry live on a page: pick it, edit its sample, switch the stage's theme, mode and width.

entries.name: Session presence
entries.summary: Whether a Claude Code session is watching the artifact, a Ping that proves it with the time it took, and the nudge that says how to start one: tell Claude Code to watch the artifact, with a Copy button.

entries.name: Prototype stage
entries.summary: An app mock-up at its real size, scaled to fit, that takes the keyboard when clicked; numbered markers, a legend and a table of every key.

entries.name: Question cards with sticky answer bar
entries.summary: Owner questions with options and a recommendation, a sticky bar counting answers, take-all, submit-all and a copy fallback.

entries.name: Record shelf
entries.summary: One card for each ADP record beside the files (the manifest, changes, parts, threads, content and the self-check), each with its figure, one line and a state in words, opening the view that shows it.

entries.name: Region frame
entries.summary: The anatomy that opens any region: an accent lead-in, icon chip, number, eyebrow, title and lede; a section label with a count; a panel led by an accent label; and a designed empty state.

entries.name: Structured report cards
entries.summary: Nine fixed-shape reports (done, blocked, decision, handoff, ask, question, feedback, fault, status): a kind pill, the subject, who and when, then only that kind's fields in a fixed order.

entries.name: Request card
entries.summary: One request to Claude as its sender follows it: kind, block, a four-station track from queued to done, the conversation with Claude's answer, progress lines, the blocks it changed, and a reply box.

entries.name: Roster, presence and claims
entries.summary: A wall of cards, one per person or agent (state and activity pills, what it holds, a queue count, a Live or Stale last-seen), a team table, and a claims table with expiry.

entries.name: Row with main action and menu
entries.summary: A row whose one main button follows its state, a menu with the rest, and round action pills that open on hover or focus.

entries.name: Live check sandbox
entries.summary: A text box that runs detectors live and lists hits; a probe table that runs async checks with timeouts and timings.

entries.name: Scenario matrix
entries.summary: What happens in each scenario under each configuration, with a verdict word per cell and a response column; also a happy-path and error-path ledger.

entries.name: Write-only secret field
entries.summary: A form for putting a value in without ever showing what is stored: masked single or multi-line input with an eye toggle, a generate-instead switch, shape hints and a cleared field after sending.

entries.name: Settings page
entries.summary: The generic settings page of the config switches: one panel per group, one row per switch with the right control, the help, the layer that enforces it, who changed it and the default when it differs, saved at once with an Undo.

entries.name: States specimen sheet
entries.summary: Every state of a component side by side, with loading, empty and missing cells, and a switch that repaints the sheet in another skin.

entries.name: Status columns and lanes
entries.summary: Cards in one column per state or per a key you switch, the waiting column widest, empty columns folded to a rail, a limit per lane, a hover glimpse, and a move that asks for a reason.

entries.name: Steps with owners, failure lines and a seam
entries.summary: An upgrade of pattern.steps: a rail of step cards with who acts (stable tone and shape per owner), when it is done, the fact it emits, a failure line, a seam where the seat changes hands and a current-step ring.

entries.name: Numbered steps
entries.summary: Big-number step list with done-when lines, id chips, gate steps and phases that count their own progress; the ticks stay in the browser.

entries.name: Timed reveal
entries.summary: A sealed card with a draining ring; open it and each value shows in place of its button for a short time, then hides itself; closing hides all of them at once.

entries.name: Verdict and status banner
entries.summary: An assessment verdict box, a status banner with a badge and a masthead with a stamp and a swappable claim sentence.

entries.name: Work card with stamps
entries.summary: One work item as a card: id, title, state, verdict, owner, what it expects, open questions, what it holds, how it ended, and who wrote what the card shows.

entries.name: Record dialog with tabs and a state crown
entries.summary: An upgrade of kit.chrome: a dialog for one record with a crown in its state colour, a tinted header (crumbs, id, close, title, tags), underline tabs and a two-column answer tab from 900px.

entries.name: Save status line
entries.summary: One line that says saved, saving, offline or local only, with the browser fallback, offline queue and refusal handled.

entries.name: Skin switch
entries.summary: An upgrade of layout.topbar: several whole-page skins in one page, applied before first paint, kept per viewer, followed across tabs and announced by an event; light and dark are separate from the skin.

entries.name: Store and db layer
entries.summary: Board state in one object with a subscribe hook, and a queued write layer over the db capability: put, update, delete, optimistic local patches, retries, the connect sequence.

entries.name: Data table
entries.summary: A table in its own scroll frame with a sticky head, numeric columns, group rows with subtotals, a total row, highlighted rows and signed figures.

entries.name: Accessible tabs
entries.summary: An ARIA tab set over the page's markup: arrow keys, Home and End, optional digit keys, and each tab a plain #anchor deep link.

entries.name: adp/2 page shell
entries.summary: The thin index.html of an adp/2 artifact. Taken as text, not by reference: copy it into your own index.html.

entries.name: Document templates
entries.summary: A long-document body on the doc shell: title block with a meta strip, numbered sections, guide and example blocks, part heads, a fill-in slot and a checklist. Taken as text.

entries.name: Lifecycle board page
entries.summary: A page for things that expire: five dial meters, the runway, the nearest seals, a trust tree tab and an inventory tab with facets and bubble pictures, and one drawer for details.

entries.name: Record page
entries.summary: One record on one page: a head with name, code and status, a seam edge, and Overview, Health and History tabs. Taken as text.

entries.name: ADR Drafting Table
entries.summary: Vellum by day, cutting mat by night; brass for the hand on the controls. The palette the owner approved, unchanged.

entries.name: Blueprint
entries.summary: Engineering sheet: whiteprint paper by day, cyanotype navy by night, 2px corners, a drafting grid under the sheet and spaced mono spec labels.

entries.name: Classic
entries.summary: Violet on deep navy with a coral companion, Sora headings and soft hero glows; the hub's reference look.

entries.name: Console
entries.summary: Mission-control telemetry: a green phosphor screen at night with a faint scanline and glow, a teletype printout by day, all monospaced.

entries.name: Default
entries.summary: The look every ADP page starts with, stated in full: cool greys, a carmine accent, Bricolage Grotesque over Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, the canvas pens, and the templates' own text size and edges.

entries.name: Glaze depth
entries.summary: The tokens the glossy Glaze parts read and the flat Glaze lacks: a lit rim, a pooled foot, gold seam stops, a bead and an ink for each meaning, neutral kind greys.

entries.name: Glaze
entries.summary: Porcelain by day, tenmoku by night, gold seams: moon-white panels on a blue-grey ground, a kiln-dark night and five glazes for meaning.

entries.name: Journal
entries.summary: Travel-magazine warmth: paper and cream cards by day, deep umber by night, terracotta and sea teal, Fraunces headlines.

entries.name: Journey Whiteboard
entries.summary: A cool workbench: chalk ground, white panels, a blue accent and six pens. Its names are the kit contract.

entries.name: Kanban
entries.summary: The dense one: cool slate neutrals, an IDE blue with a syntax purple, 14px Geist, tight 5 and 8px corners.

entries.name: Long page
entries.summary: The reading one: cool grey paper, ink blue, a stamp-red second voice, 15px on 1.6 in a 68ch measure, rounder corners and soft tinted states.

entries.name: Manuscript
entries.summary: A controlled document: a sheet of paper on a desk, blue ink for the reader and red pen for what is open, one serif voice with small-caps labels.

entries.name: Notebook
entries.summary: A cream paper notebook on a dotted desk: pastel stickers for states, rounded Fredoka, a hand-lettered Caveat, warm charcoal at night.

entries.name: War room
entries.summary: Incident room: warm grey paper or near-black, square corners, uppercase condensed headings, one signal red spent on one thing at a time.

entries.name: Theme tokens contract
entries.summary: The contract between kit css and a board’s palette: which custom properties each kit file reads, a check for missing ones, and the three theme blocks written from two maps.

entries.name: Hover and focus tooltip
entries.summary: One tooltip that follows the pointer and keyboard focus for marks in charts and grids; the shared tooltip of the visualizations.

entries.name: Type roles
entries.summary: Twenty named type roles, each a font shorthand token and a class, so no two kinds of text look alike: statements, titles, labels, hints, numerals, units, buttons, chips, code.

entries.name: View registry and layout board
entries.summary: A page drawn from a layout document: regions of blocks, each bound to a data kind and a registered view, with alternative views the viewer can switch between and a validator that refuses what it cannot draw.

entries.name: Bars to scale
entries.summary: Proportional split bar, equal-weight score bar, carried-against-total bars, an option ladder and grouped columns, every length linear from zero.

entries.name: Bubble pictures
entries.summary: The same records drawn as clusters of packed bubbles in a seam ring, or as strips on a square-root time axis that keeps overlapping items apart, with a lens line for the one in focus.

entries.name: Bucket board
entries.summary: Cards sorted into ordered buckets (MoSCoW, now/next/later): drag with a drop line, or use each card's Move to menu.

entries.name: Capability wheel
entries.summary: Eight beads round a core: lit beads are what something may do, joined by gold seams; a text alternative lists them; a button bar can light everything that has one.

entries.name: Before/after compare
entries.summary: A before, after and wipe stage over live DOM, and before/after mechanism cards.

entries.name: Chips, tallies and figures
entries.summary: The small marks every board view uses: kind and status chips, a tally strip of counts per step, a row of big figures.

entries.name: Dial meter
entries.summary: A 270 degree dial tile with a gold bead at the end of its arc, a big number and a unit; segments can split the arc by kind; the caption gives way to action buttons on hover or focus.

entries.name: One-mark-per-item grid
entries.summary: A dense grid with one mark per item, a category list that lights its marks, and an optional pointer lens.

entries.name: Flow diagrams
entries.summary: Columns of nodes joined by arrows: a source feeding sinks, a pipeline, a human step, a blocked path.

entries.name: Record focus
entries.summary: The side pane for one node of a tree: what it hangs under, the record itself, and what hangs under it, grouped by kind.

entries.name: Impact preview
entries.summary: What a change does before anyone applies it: new, changed, lost, and which targets gain or lose their last cover.

entries.name: Lease and waiter graph
entries.summary: Who holds each exclusive resource, who waits for its release, and, nested under it, each request that was turned away because of it.

entries.name: Link matrix
entries.summary: Rows against columns with a toggle per cell: which moves solve which problems, which options meet which drivers.

entries.name: Pebble map
entries.summary: Machines as glazed pebbles joined by gold seams; a seam flows while its link is up, breaks with a badge when it is down and shows a ring while connecting; a wide layout and a phone layout.

entries.name: Phase strip
entries.summary: One phase list in five forms: segmented gauge, flow boxes, itinerary, contents lines and divider tabs.

entries.name: Replay scrubber
entries.summary: Step through a board's history in creation order, with ticks placed to scale on the real time axis.

entries.name: Expiry runway
entries.summary: Twelve months along a gold seam, one lane per kind, bubbles sized by how many end that month and coloured by the worst state among them; a Later slot closes the row.

entries.name: Lifetime seal
entries.summary: A medallion whose ring is the time left, with the number in serif and a crackle that spreads over the glaze as the end nears; round action buttons fan out on hover or focus.

entries.name: To-scale capacity shelf
entries.summary: Tracks drawn on one scale, each cut into segments: used, allocated but unused, unallocated, and flagged.

entries.name: What-if slider chart
entries.summary: Sliders that redraw a column chart, readout tiles and a sentence from a model you write.

entries.name: Sparkline and waveform
entries.summary: Line and bar sparklines that state their range, and a waveform slider with marked windows.

entries.name: Step track and stages
entries.summary: Where something is in an ordered process: a compact rail for one request, and the numbered stage list of a guided flow.

entries.name: Phased time rail and event log
entries.summary: An upgrade of viz.timeline: events grouped by numbered phase with a UTC clock and day column, a ping on events that need a person, and a time-first table drawn as a log.

entries.name: Vertical timeline and roadmap
entries.summary: Event timeline with glyph-and-word status dots that light linked cards, and numbered roadmap phases.

entries.name: Clickable topology
entries.summary: SVG node diagram in zones with links; picking a node fills a detail panel.

entries.name: Lineage tree
entries.summary: Records as a left-to-right tree: each drawn once under its first parent, other parents as dashed edges, the selected node's whole lineage lit.

entries.name: Trust tree
entries.summary: A signing hierarchy drawn as porcelain medallions on gold seams: pick or hover one and the chain up to the root lights; arrow keys walk it; phones get a nested list.

entries.name: Version compare
entries.summary: Two versions of an ADP artifact side by side: a version line, a tally, the parts added, removed and changed between them, who changed each and when, a line diff of the text, and the data changes in between.

entries.name: Key wheel and mood plot
entries.summary: The Camelot key wheel with neighbours or per-key counts, a key chip with its hue, and a 0 to 100 valence and arousal plot.

entries.name: Swimlane schematic with dependency wires
entries.summary: Items as nodes on lanes by phases, joined by orthogonal wires drawn from their dependencies; a filter dims, never hides.

entries.name: State vocabulary and marks
entries.summary: One table gives every state its word, short word, glyph, tone and motion; pills, chips, orbs, checkbox tiles, lane heads and a key all read it, and a silent value draws nothing.
